bulkUpload.subtitle: Add multiple products at once — AI fills in the details
bulkUpload.selectSubtitle: Choose all photos you want to add — you'll group them in the next step. Works great from your phone's camera roll.
bulkUpload.takePhotoHint: Point your camera at each item — tap again for the next one
bulkUpload.fileHint: JPG, PNG, HEIC · Multiple selection supported · Max 8 MB per photo

bulkUpload.selectAtLeast2: Select at least 2 photos to group
bulkUpload.reviewSubtitle: The AI has suggested names, descriptions, and categories. Edit anything that needs correcting and set the price for each item. Uncheck any product to skip it.
bulkUpload.analysisSub: About 10 seconds per photo — a large batch takes a few minutes
bulkUpload.publishedSub: Your new items are now live in the catalogue.
